newsitem.title: CHINA: Phillips Petroleum in China chemicals pact.
newsitem.headline: Phillips Petroleum in China chemicals pact.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co of the United States and China Petrochemical Corp (Sinopec) have signed a letter of intent to expand cooperation in the petrochemical and fine chemical sectors, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

The agreement includes an expansion of high density polyethylene production at a joint venture project now under development by Phillips and a Sinopec subsidiary, Shanghai Petrochemical Co, the news agency said.
The two sides had planned to produce 100,000 tonnes of polyethylene annually on completion but the new accord calls for an eventual increase in output to between 200,000 and 250,000 tonnes a year.
Xinhua did not say when the project would go into operation or when output would reach the newly targeted levels.
Phillips has 40 percent of the venture while Shanghai Petrochemical has 60 percent.

Sinopec and Phillips also agreed to cooperate on a number of other projects linked to an ethylene cracker, polypropylene, high density polyethylene pipe, K-resin copolymer and other petrochemical products, Xinhua said without giving details.
